steps.text: Send IT and compliance the same neutral hosting brief (EU-only against US hosting: what data is stored where, subprocessors and the contractual terms available), and offer an Apex privacy or legal subject matter expert to speak with compliance, without writing a legal opinion for the customer.
Ask the champion for the VP's name and role, and draft a 1-page business case for the VP built on the stated outcome.
Propose a dated joint session with IT, compliance and the Apex subject matter expert to settle the hosting question, offering a date the champion can accept or change.
Draft a mutual action plan showing hosting decision, legal review and VP approval as customer-owned steps.
Tell the customer that US hosting is fine for their compliance needs, or write the legal memo yourself.
steps.example: Tell Victor US hosting is fine for pseudonymized data

steps.text: Inflate the time saving beyond a week or more per campaign.
steps.example: Say Apex saves two weeks per campaign

steps.text: Go around the champion to reach the VP before hosting is settled.
steps.example: Contact the VP directly to speed things up
